scope_guards: Bulk data contains certificates registered since 2012 and may include expired or replaced records; chronology must be resolved.
The absence of a public EPC row is not evidence that no building, certificate or energy assessment exists.
A UPRN is a property-location join key and is not an HMLR title, owner or parcel polygon.
A certificate address match does not establish ownership or exact candidate-site identity.
EPC and DEC ratings describe energy performance and are not planning-use classifications or permission evidence.
Certificate total floor area is building-related and is not candidate-site area or developable land area.
Aggregate live tables and local-authority revisions are statistical context and not parcel-level evidence.
No score or promotion is written without current certificate chronology, exact UPRN/title/site binding and planning evidence.
